The package conflicts with alternative versions (`lektra`, `lektra-git`), which is a standard precaution. No dangerous commands (e.g., `eval`, `curl|bash`, `wget`) are present, and no runtime modifications or network calls occur within the PKGBUILD. The package adheres to typical AUR packaging standards and shows no evidence of supply-chain tampering or malicious behavior.
